method: Reviewed the complete lesson, its source-bound checkpoint, metadata and historical evidence boundaries. A local verifier compiled all four Python fences, reproduced default urllib credential forwarding between two loopback servers using only a dummy token, and confirmed the lesson transport stops at 302 without reaching the redirect target. Built the production site and search index, then inspected full-page light/dark screenshots at a 1300px viewport and checked article width, horizontal overflow, Mermaid rendering and console after theme reload. No provider calls or external network requests were made.
limitations: The redirect regression uses only loopback servers and a dummy credential in the current Python runtime; it does not cover other Python versions, proxy behavior, DNS, TLS, provider redirects, or production network policy.
Rejecting redirects does not validate the configured base URL or credentials and is not a complete outbound-network control.
The verifier compiles but does not execute the full provider-backed lesson harness; historical model traces, per-step usage and click behavior remain unavailable for replay.
The screenshots cover one production lesson at one desktop viewport in two themes; an initial favicon 404 was not repeated after reload.
